---
title: "`mousike`"
---


`mousike` is a Python package to parse ancient Greek musical notation, align it with parallel textual editions, and translate musical texts to MIDI representations.

## Fonts

*Mousike Notation* is a font with all the characters used to display Greek musical notation.
